text:
fiona_ops: vendor just notified of a partial hold: 14/40 H100s released, 26 held until a revised expedite agreement. ETA shift +3wks. we need plan: loaners now vs air top-up.
marcus_procure: what's the expedite premium? can we negotiate a ceiling?
tim_vendor: immediate air lane = +9% surcharge + EUR 3,800 AWB handling. consolidated single AWB if accepted reduces to +5% but needs single pickup slot and warehousing. vendor will print warranty on docs if we confirm HS.
elliot_sre: EU pools hitting 80% util; risk of throttles in 8-10 days. loaners will buy ~10-14 days. air recommended for replenishment.
fiona_ops: forwarder recs? depot accept in NL/DE <48h required.
tim_vendor: SkySprint guarantees 36h depot acceptance (higher cost). FastParcel ~60-72h cheaper.
marcus_procure: propose Redwood cap expedite at +6% and vendor absorbs excess if they missed original ETA. acceptable?
tim_vendor: vendor asks 50/50 or they keep holdback. will try to accept 6% if we sign conditional release.
fiona_ops: @rma-bot can we pre-create return path for loaners/defects to stamp on AWB?
rma-bot: RMA created: RMA-9016. Include RMA-9016 on AWB and photos.
fiona_ops: preferred AWB format to reduce customs friction: ```
AWB: SS-442-700
Pieces: 14
Declared value: EUR 280,000
RMA: RMA-9016
HS: 8471.80
Note: "Warranty/Replacement" printed
```
marcus_procure: ask vendor for two formal quotes (SkySprint & FastParcel) with line items: air-surcharge, brokerage, insurance, AWB fee. need by EOD.
elliot_sre: I'll model cost_of_premium vs estimated SLA revenue loss once quotes in.
fiona_ops: action items: 1) vendor to send quotes + AWB sample by EOD - @tim_vendor; 2) procurement to reply on ceiling by 11:00 UTC tomorrow - @marcus_procure; 3) ops to prep loaner manifest and depot list - @fiona_ops. reconvene after quotes. :thumbsup:
